items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: A guy called Franky Dusen. He'd end up all night. For months and months Bunk didn't go home, sleep on the pool table, time to go play.

ctx.x: Oh. Harrison Gougie. I know. That's what I'm saying. That's just what I'm saying right now. That's just what I'm saying right now. I'm glad you brought man because we could think of some people. Then we have another Creole boy called Ogin. Ogin? Ogin. From way down on, Mary Sugar refiner played trumpet, hold his head down and played some of the sweet... He wasn't no high note man but he played some of the nicest stuff with the old ugly hooker guy. Oh. Yeah. They don't write with those guys. They don't know. Yeah,…
